messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "confirm milliliters if prescription is in milligrams"
set: ["confirm milliliters if prescription is in milligrams", "increase is needed if additional glycemic control is required", "tell healthcare provider if taking prescription or over-the-counter medicines", "even if blood sugar is normal", "replace your inhaler if it is washed or placed in water", "dose is given in 3 divided doses", "read instructions for use with prescription", "valid prescription from licensed healthcare provider", "follow directions on prescription label carefully", "follow all directions on prescription label", "tell doctor about all prescription medications", "consult doctor or pharmacist if using without prescription and have medical conditions", "stop taking if diarrhea is watery or bloody", "is normal", "call your doctor if the child is restless", "call your doctor if the child is hostile"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
